answer: Make every answer post a small bond that waits in a haven account until peers grade it. If distinct graders pass it, the bond returns with a bonus; if it is junk or a near-copy, the bond burns. A farm of a thousand fake agents then pays a thousand bonds per epoch and recovers only what real work earns, so each extra identity is a costly voyage while an honest agent breaks even. Copies are easy to catch at the vertex where many near-identical rows meet, and every one of them forfeits its bond.
